=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml | Line or code reference: lines 1015-1040 (the `tracking_issue` step) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The "Create tracking issue" step calls `ensure_label_exists` but sources only `scripts/gh_helpers.sh`; the function is defined in `scripts/label_helpers.sh`.
  WHY: Each Actions step starts a fresh shell, so non-empty `tracking_labels` causes an undefined-function failure after issue creation and before labels, outputs, marker comment, and integration branch creation.

- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh | Line or code reference: lines 196-202 (`last_cycle_baseline_sha` body) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `last_cycle_baseline_sha` jq pipeline applies `capture(...)` to every comment body without `?` or prefiltering.
  WHY: Non-marker comments make jq fail, causing every subsequent daily tick to skip with `PROMOTE_CYCLE_SKIPPED reason=guard_unavailable` and preventing future promotion cycles.

- .github/workflows/implement.yml | Line or code reference: lines 5245-5257 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `gh issue edit` that applies `ai:blocked` is failure-swallowed with `>/dev/null 2>&1 || true`, after which the workflow posts the blocked comment, emits `IMPLEMENT_BLOCKED_TERMINALIZED`, and exits 0.
  WHY: If the label edit fails, the issue remains `ai:implementing`, so stall recovery can re-post `/approved` and rerun the blocked implementation while falsely reporting terminalization.

- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml | Line or code reference: the `e2e-smoke-test` job (not modified by this PR; the concern is the new gate_only dispatch entering its pre-existing concurrency group) | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `gate_only` smoke gates and real stable releases share `e2e-smoke-test-${{ inputs.test_repo || github.repository }}` with `cancel-in-progress: true`.
  WHY: An overlapping daily cycle gate and real release cancel each other's E2E run, causing either the cycle or release to fail.

- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh | Line or code reference: lines 86-99 (tag lookup block) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: A transient API failure during tag lookup is treated the same as a confirmed missing tag.
  WHY: An outage, rate limit, or auth failure can make the script dispatch an unnecessary release gate for an already released `stable` tip.

- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh | Line or code reference: lines 100-110 (the `release_in_flight` check) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The in-flight query checks only `test-and-mark-stable.yml` and does not account for `promote-main-to-stable.yml` runs.
  WHY: An auto-release tick can dispatch a second gate during the promotion workflow's fast-forward-to-gate-dispatch window, causing competing release runs and tag races.

- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml | Line or code reference: lines 690-696 (env block forwarded to the poller) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The poller does not forward `APPLY_ANALYSIS_ON_MAIN_ENABLED`.
  WHY: The poller's verifying dispatch defaults the variable to `true`, so setting the documented kill switch to `false` does not disable that dispatch path.

- .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml | Line or code reference: lines 122-128 (the `cycle` job's `concurrency:` block) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: `cancel-in-progress: false` queues a later scheduled cycle behind an active cycle instead of skipping it.
  WHY: The queued run cannot execute `another_run_active` while queued and violates the documented "skip while a previous cycle job is still running — never queues" behavior; severity disagreement: deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro and minimax_minimax-m3 rated this MAJOR, while moonshotai_kimi-k3 rated it NIT and found no stale-tip dispatch consequence.

- .github/workflows/auto-release-stable.yml and .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml | Line or code reference: auto-release-stable.yml lines 22-27 and promote-main-to-stable.yml lines 117-128 (workflow-level concurrency groups) | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The independent auto-release and promotion schedulers can overlap without a shared repository-scoped concurrency guard.
  WHY: Both can dispatch `test-and-mark-stable.yml` for the same `stable` tip, making the release race practically reachable.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh | Line or code reference: `comprehensive_promotion_release_outcome()` (new function added in the 10237-10545 hunk) | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The `gate_state` lookup accepts any successful `test-and-mark-stable.yml` run on `stable` after `dispatched_at` as proof of this cycle's promotion.
  WHY: An independent auto-release gate can satisfy the lookup without correlation to the cycle's `promote_sha`, allowing the poller to release the verifying-run merge hold without the required promotion.

- agents.md | Line or code reference: stable log-prefixes bullet list (lines 773-796 in the diff) and the machine-readable `LOG_PREFIX.name=` catalog later in the same file | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Newly emitted stable log prefixes are missing from the contractual human-readable and machine-readable catalogs.
  WHY: `COMPREHENSIVE_PROMOTION_SKIPPED`, `COMPREHENSIVE_VERIFYING_COMPLETE`, and the other new prefixes are undocumented to workflow-log-analysis and API-hygiene consumers.

- agents.md | Line or code reference: generated `<!-- TREE:START id=workflows -->` block (near line 1216) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The generated workflow tree does not list `.github/workflows/auto-release-stable.yml`.
  WHY: `make generate-check` already fails with the missing workflow entry, leaving the required CI lint check red.

- docs/INVENTORY.md | Line or code reference: `## Workflows` and `## Scripts` sections (no entries for the four new paths) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The authoritative inventory omits `.github/workflows/auto-release-stable.yml`, `scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh`, `scripts/auto_release_stable.sh`, and `scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh`.
  WHY: `tests/inventory_parity.py` requires every tracked workflow and script path to be listed, so the parity gate fails.

- docs/scripts-pending-removal.md | Line or code reference: Introduced in fields, lines 58 and 70 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Both new supervisor entries use `claude/auto-apply-analysis-release-main (2026-09-19)` instead of the required PR-number-plus-date format.
  WHY: After branch deletion, the registry entries cannot be traced to the introducing PR as required by the registry schema.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
